title: docs(fields): the percent page and catalog teach `scale` for the decimal width (objectui#11255)
body:
Fixes #11255

Clause-②: no

## What this changes

Every percent face reads its decimal places from `scale` through `resolveFieldScale` (`@objectstack/spec/data`), and none reads `precision`, which the spec declares as the total digit count. The percent docs page and two schema catalog entries still taught `precision` as the decimal width, so a copied example rendered the protocol's default width (whole percents) instead of the decimals the page promised.

- `content/docs/fields/percent.mdx`
  - heading `## With Precision` is now `## With Decimal Places`, embedding `fields-percent/with-decimal-places`;
  - the Field Schema prose names "the decimal places (`scale`), the total-digit `precision` and the two bounds", matching `PercentFieldMetadata.scale` from objectui#9784;
  - the snippet declares `scale: 2` instead of `precision: 2`;
  - a new paragraph says decimal places come from `scale`, not `precision`, with the widths a stored `0.855` shows with and without `scale`;
  - the Cell Renderer comment names the stored value and the `scale` behind `85.50%`, plus the `86%` the same value shows with no `scale`.
- `examples/schema-catalog`
  - `fields-percent/with-decimal-precision` is renamed `fields-percent/with-decimal-places` (title "With Decimal Places", slug-derived) and declares `scale: 1`;
  - `fields-percent/required-percent` declares `scale: 2`;
  - `src/index.ts` is regenerated by `scripts/regenerate-catalog-index.py` (not hand-edited); `--check` reports it up to date.
- New pin `examples/schema-catalog/test/fields-percent-scale-11255.test.tsx`
  - renders both entries through the real `SchemaRenderer`, form renderer and `@object-ui/fields` registration, and asserts the input `step` their `scale` sets (`0.1`, `0.01`);
  - each width reading has a control: the same entry with `scale` moved back to `precision` must step by `1`, so a step that ignored both keys cannot pass;
  - backs the two widths the page states for a stored `0.855`: read-only display and table cell, `85.50%` with `scale: 2` and `86%` with no `scale`.

No other file names the old id: `git grep with-decimal-precision` at the base gave the docs page and `index.ts` only. No snapshot or census pins it.

## Premise check (at base `7728c67c86`)

- The page still taught `precision` in its heading, embedded example id, prose and snippet. `with-decimal-precision.json` declared `precision: 1` and `required-percent.json` declared `precision: 2`.
- Faces read `scale`. `PercentCellRenderer` (`packages/fields/src/index.tsx`) and the `PercentField` edit widget both call `resolveFieldScale` with the field's `scale`. The remaining `.precision` reads in `packages/*/src` are forwarders that copy the key into field metadata, not width reads.
- The page's width claim was measured through the real renderers, not read off the code:

| reading | before (as on `main`) | after |
|---|---|---|
| `with-decimal-*` entry, input `step` | `1` (with `precision: 1`) | `0.1` (with `scale: 1`) |
| `required-percent`, input `step` | `1` (with `precision: 2`) | `0.01` (with `scale: 2`) |
| `PercentCellRenderer`, stored `0.855` | `86%` (with `precision: 2`) | `85.50%` (with `scale: 2`) |

The seeded `0.753` in the first entry shows as `75.3` while editing. With the old entry that value sat off its whole-percent step.

## Ablations (one-shot, from the committed state, each through `ablation-replace.mjs` with an on-disk mutation proof and a proven restore: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty)

- A. Edit widget pointed at `precision` instead of `scale`: predicted 3 red / 1 green, observed `Tests 3 failed | 1 passed (4)`. The step readings got `1` where `0.1` / `0.01` were expected, and the read-only display read `86%`.
- B. Catalog entry `"scale": 1` back to `"precision": 1`: observed `Tests 1 failed | 3 passed (4)`.
- C. `PercentCellRenderer` pointed at `precision`: observed `Tests 1 failed | 3 passed (4)`, with the cell reading `86%`.
- D. Snippet `scale: 2,` changed to `scale: 'two',`: `check:doc-snippets` turned red with TS2322 on percent.mdx (`775 of 775 block(s) judged, 1 failed`). That proves the gate really compiles this page's snippet.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope, same family, not touched here: `content/docs/fields/number.mdx` still heads its decimal example `## With Precision`, and `fields-number/decimal-numbers` declares `precision: 2`.
  - Measured through the real renderer: that entry's input steps by `any`, exactly as with no declaration, and `NumberCellRenderer` shows a stored `1234.5` as `1,234.5`.
  - With `scale: 2` it steps by `0.01` and shows `1,234.50`.
  - It is in the dev report for the seat to file. It is outside this card's declared file surface.
- Install note: this container's node is 22.22.0, and `jsdom@30` declares `^22.22.2`. With the repo's `engine-strict=true`, a bare `pnpm install` refuses, so the worktree was installed with `--config.engine-strict=false`. CI is unaffected.
